notes.A_config: sigma_atlas (atlas std, no shock, 1000 candles) is used as the proxy of the ensemble-configuration M1 std; sigma^2_atlas,mix is the within-candidate (equal-weight) mixture proxy without between-candidate mean variance
notes.windows: V_real,M1 primary = mean variance of the 300 mapping windows (rows [60j, 60j+1000]); variant = all estimation origins with valid windows
notes.h24: VR_real for h12/h24 normalises by the 1000-row forward window variance (not the same time span)
